label: lem:topological-mass-dilogarithm
title: Quantum dilogarithm evaluation of exceptional-divisor contributions
html:
Lemma. Quantum dilogarithm evaluation of exceptional-divisor contributions

Each exceptional-divisor summand evaluates to the quantum dilogarithm in the spectral coordinates of the Briggs--Klein chart at E_i:

  \bigl\lVert
  \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_{E_i}
  \bigl(\nabla_A q, L \wedge F^+\bigr)
  \bigr\rVert
  =
  \Phi_q(z_i)
  =
  \int_0^{z_i} \frac{\ln_q(1+t)}{t}\, dt.
